variants.prompt: On the deck of a sleek, black yacht gliding through moonlit waters, this siren reclines against a velvet-upholstered lounge, her fiery tresses spilling across an ivory silk throw. A diamond necklace glimmers against porcelain skin as emerald eyes glint with mischief under the star-flecked sky. The halter dress clings to every curve before plunging to reveal the tantalizing swell of her thighs.
